title: Localize cheat catalog presentation and refresh embedded languages
platforms: Desktop: Linux unit tests and synthetic incremental build; Windows GUI not rechecked
changes: Use the selected language for read-only cheat catalog rows, selector notices and information labels while preserving imported entries, IDs, ROM hashes and catalog/CLI JSON. Document the existing limited one-shot separately from the original read-only catalog validation.
Watch each embedded language JSON as well as its directory, so incremental Cargo builds regenerate translations after edits and continue discovering additions or removals.
validation: Offline tests: 11 debug-cheats tests passed, 1 private-catalog test ignored; 14 content-selector tests and 2 information tests passed; 4 language-catalog tests passed. Synthetic rows preserve imported JSON and stable IDs in English and Italian.

An isolated copy of the actual build script regenerated its registry after editing a catalog and after adding and removing a synthetic locale. Catalog checker passed 487/487 entries per language; git diff --check passed.
limitations: No live GUI, native Windows, physical-controller, real-catalog, cheat-application or ROM validation was performed. Cheat row text is localized when the catalog is opened or reloaded; catalog capability metadata and the existing manual one-shot limits remain unchanged.
